name: SKINLESS: Body-Horror Immersion Mod
subcategory: underground game circuit / reality-bleed horror mod
description: A notorious mod built on the HOLLOW SKIN engine, SKINLESS strips away all geneware and chrome from the player's simulated body and forces them to experience a full 24-hour neural immersion as a completely unaugmented human in contemporary GLMZ — the sensory deprivation, the social invisibility, the physical vulnerability — calibrated to maximum fidelity with no comfort governors. Passed hand-to-hand through encrypted Tier 1-2 networks, SKINLESS has developed a cult following that is equal parts masochistic, political, and genuinely disturbed. Neurologists consider it among the most psychologically dangerous BCI experiences currently in circulation.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive secretly plays SKINLESS once a month and is becoming increasingly unable to function in augmented reality — their neural therapy sessions are being billed to a shell company.
The anonymous developer of SKINLESS reaches out to a journalist, claiming the mod was originally commissioned by a corponation as a psychological compliance research tool.
A Tier 1 aug-rejection activist who has played SKINLESS over a hundred times starts reporting experiences in the mod that go beyond the programmed parameters — things that shouldn't be there.
